title: Node Out-of-Memory (OOMKilled) Pod Recovery
symptom: Pods in CrashLoopBackOff with OOMKilled exit reason; node memory pressure alerts firing.
remediation_steps: Identify OOMKilled pods: kubectl get pods --field-selector=status.phase=Failed -o wide
Inspect memory limits: kubectl describe pod <pod-name> | grep -A5 Limits
Patch resource limits: kubectl set resources deployment/<name> --limits=memory=512Mi
Restart deployment: kubectl rollout restart deployment/<name>
